articles.title: New Ownership of Longstanding PostalAnnex Location in Temecula, California Offering Shipping and Office Services for Over 20 Years
articles.mainIdea: New Ownership of Longstanding PostalAnnex Location in Temecula, California Offering Shipping and Office Services for Over 20 Years
articles.summary: PR Newswire: New Ownership of Longstanding PostalAnnex Location in Temecula, California Offering Shipping and Office Services for Over 20 Years. Annex Brands, Inc., a leading franchisor in the packing, shipping, and office services industries, is pleased to announce the successful transfer of ownership of an existing PostalAnnex location in Temecula, CA to new owner, Jason Francisco. This transition to new ownership ensures that the community will continue to benefit from the more than 20 years of expert shipping and office services provided by this PostalAnnex location. Related tickers mentioned: DHLGY, UPS.
